Even common solvents and solutions can pose health risks from short- and long-term exposure.
84%
of lab managers* worry about
chemical vapors and leaks
When working with hazardous chemicals, minimize your risk using Agilent InfinityLab environmental, health, and safety (EHS) supplies. They are compatible with InfinityLab LC Series instruments and can be integrated seamlessly into your LC workflow.

Vapors
Worried about solvent evaporation and the escape of harmful vapors?
Stop solvents from leaching into the air with
InfinityLab Stay Safe caps
.
Easily and safely purge up to four LC solvent lines with
InfinityLab Stay Safe purging bottles
.
Minimize the risk of spills with
InfinityLab solvent bottles and waste canisters
.
Reduce evaporation during sampling by choosing
InfinityLab well plates and sealing mats
.
Speed up your analysis and reduce solvent use by choosing
InfinityLab Poroshell 120 columns
.
Leaks
Need to prevent leaks?
Maintain tight connections using
InfinityLab Quick Connect and Quick Turn fittings.
Capture particles before they reach the LC column with
InfinityLab Quick Change inline filters.
Are other EHS concerns holding your lab back? Agilent can help.

Prevent waste from contaminating users and instruments by using
InfinityLab waste canisters with Stay Safe caps
.
Speed up your analysis and reduce solvent use by choosing
InfinityLab Poroshell 120 columns
.

Ergonomics
Want to minimize repetitive strain and heavy lifting?
Keep your LC instrument, solvent bottles, and more within easy reach with an
InfinityLab Flex Bench
.
Reduce repetitive wrench work in narrow spaces using tool-free
InfinityLab fittings
.
Carry solvents safely and ergonomically by storing them in
InfinityLab solvent bottles
.
Protect your valuable columns against particle clogging with finger-tight
InfinityLab Quick Change inline filters
.
Distracted by noisy vacuum pumps?
Promote a more peaceful lab environment with an
Agilent Quiet Cover
.
Electrical hazards
Concerned about the risk of shock?
Keep solvents and waste away from electronics with InfinityLab leak sensors and waste funnels.
Avoid multiple cable connections by organizing power cords in an
InfinityLab Flex Bench MS with a power strip
.
For extra peace-of-mind,
Agilent LC/MS ion sources
are fully grounded, and high-voltage components are shielded within the instrument.

Less stress, more
peace-of-mind
Acetonitrile and methanol are just two of the many toxic compounds that you may be exposed to every day. Stay Safe caps stop solvents from leaching into the air, protecting both you and your coworkers. What’s more, they install easily—just like standard caps.

Agilent InfinityLab Flex Bench family
Easily reconfigure your stack for any application. Our sturdy Flex Bench also keeps your LC instrument, solvent bottles, and more within easy reach, minimizing the risk of accidents. This live demo shows you how to optimize lab space and simplify your LC system configuration.

Update your browser to view video.
Making great LC connections
Conventional fittings are nonadjustable, require specialized wrenches to install, and are subject to over-tightening, which can cause the fitting to get stuck in the column. Agilent InfinityLab Quick Connect fittings are finger-tight, leakproof, and stable up to 1300 bar.
